title: Small-model surjection onto etale generator sections
statement: For every scheme X in universe u and every U in the opposite of its small etale site, there is a type α : Type u and a surjection α → ((etaleSmallGenerator X).obj.obj U).

source.place: Sheafified free abelian representables and the affine-open covering argument

proof.text: Compute sections on the u-small affine model as a u-small coproduct of u-small coefficient groups, transport along the dense-site equivalences, and use restriction to a u-small affine-open covering to obtain a surjection from a Type u onto sections. The empty covering is handled by the singleton domain.

proof_origin.place: Free abelian representable sheaves; universe-explicit affine-model construction
